about_the_game:
This software is a walking character asset pack designed for RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ.

 

It includes walking characters inspired by people commonly found in schools, such as teachers and students. These can be used as background NPCs to blend naturally into school-themed projects. By combining this pack with the released “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET Japanese School” you can further enrich the atmosphere of your school-themed creations.

 

As a bonus, this pack also includes base characters (12 total: 6 with faces and 6 faceless). These can be used to create your own original walking characters that match the style of this set.

 

Please note that this pack does not include face graphics or battle sprites.

This pack does not include background tilesets.

Included Assets

  • 32 School Walking Characters

  • 6 Base Walking Characters (with faces)

  • 6 Base Walking Characters (faceless)
